description:
How many residents live with arthritis, asthma, cancer, dementia, diabetes, heart disease, a mental health condition, stroke and other long-term conditions, and how many have more than one, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,000 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/health-conditions`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, arthritis_count, arthritis_pct, asthma_count, asthma_pct, cancer_count, cancer_pct, dementia_count, dementia_pct, diabetes_count, diabetes_pct, heart_disease_count, heart_disease_pct, kidney_disease_count, kidney_disease_pct, lung_condition_count, lung_condition_pct, mental_health_condition_count, mental_health_condition_pct, stroke_count, stroke_pct, other_condition_count, other_condition_pct, no_condition_count, no_condition_pct, any_named_condition_count, any_named_condition_pct, no_named_condition_count, no_named_condition_pct, one_named_condition_count, one_named_condition_pct, two_named_conditions_count, two_named_conditions_pct, three_plus_named_conditions_count, three_plus_named_conditions_pct, not_stated_count, not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_area_stats_health_conditions
title: LGA · Long-term health conditions
